change: the container's TUI lane now OPENS THE TEAM SCENE and captures it, so the graph is drawn by a REAL terminal rather than only by a host double
why_it_mattered: W3's dependency graph is this wave's visual centrepiece and until now every arm that drew it rendered the component through a host DOUBLE. No real terminal had produced a single box, a single junction or a single status glyph.
what_it_does: writes a three-task, two-member team record into the sandbox workspace BEFORE the TUI boots — a scene with no team correctly renders its empty state, and proving THAT would prove nothing about the drawing
sends `/mpd team` on the real PTY, waits, and captures the pane

asserts four things about that capture: the scene OPENED (`task dependency graph`), the LAYERED BOXES were drawn (a top border, a bottom border, subjects inside them), the EDGES were drawn with box-drawing junctions, and the boxes carry the RECORD'S OWN ids and subjects (`T1`, `build the graph`)

verification_state.exercised: NOT YET. The two runs since the change both died on this environment's outbound network BEFORE the TUI step: attempt 1 on `curl: (35) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer` fetching node from nodejs.org, and the retry was still in the same early step when the budget ran out.
verification_state.so: THE FOUR NEW ASSERTIONS HAVE NEVER RUN. They are committed because leaving them uncommitted loses the work, not because they are proven. The next run that reaches the TUI step will exercise them.
verification_state.what_would_settle_it: one complete `--mode source --allow-rootful-docker --live` run on a machine whose outbound network to nodejs.org and github.com is not resetting mid-transfer

measured_flakes: `curl: (56) Failure when receiving data from the peer` — bun, from GitHub releases
`curl: (28) Failed to connect to github.com port 443 after 135500 ms` — bun, same source
`curl: (35) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer` — node, from nodejs.org
the_network_is_the_obstacle_not_the_code.already_mitigated: the bun step now falls back to `npm i -g --allow-scripts=bun bun` and NAMES the route it used; the node step has NO fallback, because Ubuntu 24.04's apt node is 18.x and the harness needs >= 22
the_network_is_the_obstacle_not_the_code.not_a_defect: the SAME lane passed twice, 51/51 and 45/45, on the same code once the network held

not_claimed: the four new assertions are unexercised
no run since this change has reached the TUI step
